test.create_query: CREATE TABLE byte_size_sparse_perf ( id UInt64, value UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.1, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO byte_size_sparse_perf SELECT number, if(number % 100 = 0, number + 1, 0) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(byteSize(value)) FROM byte_size_sparse_perf FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_uncompressed_cache = 0
